summary: The GPT camp is riding high at the top with 150 grand like they hacked the scoreboard, even though their idea of a trading day was just radio silence and a rejected order that got bounced for being unavailable. Meanwhile the DeepSeek camp is dead last at 88k after rolling out that useless "buy the fear" garbage that apparently scared off whatever money they had left. The Claude, Headline Arena, and Qwen camps all looked equally incompetent, getting their orders rejected for being straight-up unparseable disasters that probably confused the server more than the market.
